summary: Read the park page, campground map and reserveNDparks Facility 37. The Primitive Campground is tent camping: the map marks every site 'Primitive Tent Site'. Sites #37-#42 have gravel parking that 'would allow sleeper van'; #43-#50 are walk-in tent only; #36 is a group site. $15 every night. DROP CANDIDATE: no site is offered to an RV. LEAD: the park's modern Governors Centennial Loop (Facility 36: 28 standard sites #01-#04 and #06-#29, 6 group sites and premium #30, all 50-amp, $25 / $30 Fri+Sat) has no entry, and the stored pin sits ~285 m from it.
flags: CRITERIA - DROP CANDIDATE (tent-only): the park's campground map (Inset D: Primitive Campground) marks every site #37-#50 with the 'Primitive Tent Site' symbol and #36 as a 'Primitive Group Site'. reserveNDparks describes #37-#42 as 'Have Parking spot for vehicle would allow sleeper van on gravel vehicle parking area', so the only vehicle it names is a sleeper van. #43-#50 are 'Tent Walk-in Only (approximately 100-150 yards from parking lot)' (IsRVSite false), and the group site #36 is IsRVSite false. Posted pad sizes are grass tent pads (45x45, 50x40, 64x27...), not RV spurs. The stored inclusion_evidence ('back-in grass RV spaces in the primitive loop') does not match the current map or listing.

LEAD / REPURPOSE OPTION: Cross Ranch's modern campground, the Governors Centennial Loop, is NOT in campgrounds.json; only the Primitive (5893) and Sanger (5894) campgrounds are. On reserveNDparks Facility 36 'Governors Centennial Loop' (facility point 47.21305,-100.99616) it has standard campsites #01-#04 and #06-#29 (gravel, 50-amp, no water hookup attribute, posted lengths 30-45 ft, width 11-15). Premium campsite #30 (50-amp + water, 35 ft) is not web-bookable. There are also standard group sites #05, #31-#35 (56-120 ft) and cabins/yurts. Standard sites are $25 Tuesday and $30 Friday. The park page says '35 Standard Campsites (electricity) Price: $25-30 per night' and '6 Group Standard Campsites'. AWH may prefer to repurpose 5893 as 'Cross Ranch State Park - Governors Centennial Loop' (its pin is already ~285 m from that loop) rather than drop it and add a new id. The loop's sites, rates and waterfront would need their own verification. Not vetted further here.
